[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
driving pulse-wave lead with an urgent climbing minor melody
pounding plucked sampled bass in unbroken eighths
dark pipe-organ chords and tense string pad
eerie detuned high shimmer like light draining away
sampled march snare, timpani and tom fills pressing relentlessly forward
seamless transition back to the theme
